anomalies.observed: The 25 MHz crystal HSE1 is wired between FCC1 pin 5 (PE6) and pin 37 (PE7). FCC1 pin 12 (PH0) is tied only to C14 (2u2) to GND, and pin 13 (PH1) is tied to the VREF+_FCC net (R21/C30).
anomalies.expected: For the STM32H753VITx, the HSE crystal must connect to PH0 (pin 12) and PH1 (pin 13). PE6/PE7 cannot serve as the HSE oscillator pins.
anomalies.impact: The FCC1 MCU will not receive its intended 25 MHz external clock; it may fail to start or run at an incorrect frequency, making the flight controller non-functional.

anomalies.observed: All FCC1 VDD pins (11, 27, 50, 75, 100), VDDA (21) and VREF+ (20) are left unconnected. The decoupling capacitors C16–C26 etc. are on the +3V3 net, but no FCC1 power pin is on that net.
anomalies.expected: The STM32H753VITx VDD pins must be connected to the 3.3 V rail (+3V3), VDDA to the analog supply, and VREF+ to the voltage reference, per the specification that the FCC is powered from the 3.3 V regulator.
anomalies.impact: The FCC1 MCU has no supply applied to its VDD pins, so it will not power up or operate.

anomalies.observed: NAVC1 VDD pins (19, 32, 48, 64) are unconnected. Its VSS pins (18, 63) are tied only to each other on Net-(NAVC1-VSS-Pad18) and not to GND. All I2C, UART, GPIO and sensor interface pins of NAVC1 are unconnected, while the corresponding nets (I2C1_SCL_NAVC, I2C1_SDA_NAVC, UART2_TX_NAVC, UART2_RX_NAVC, GPIO_A_NAVC, etc.) exist only on the peripheral side.
anomalies.expected: The STM32F405RGTx must be powered from +3V3, grounded to GND, and connected to the sensors, GPS, EEPROM and FCC via the I2C, UART and GPIO nets described in the specification.
anomalies.impact: The NAVC MCU is not powered, not grounded, and has no I/O connections, so it cannot perform navigation, sensor fusion or communicate with the FCC.
